info.title: UserCenter Module API
info.description:
REST API for the UserCenter module (authentication, user management, role/menu/permission management).

## Authentication

All protected endpoints require a JWT bearer token issued by `/auth/login`, `/auth/login-phone`, `/auth/register`, or `/auth/refresh`. Send the token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

Role-based authorization uses `spatie/laravel-permission`. Endpoints marked with a `permission:` requirement need the named permission on the authenticated user's roles. The super-admin role (`super_admin`) bypasses all permission checks.

## Response envelope

Every JSON response is wrapped by `App\Http\Middleware\NormalizeApiResponse`, which:

- Injects a business `code` field: `0` for success (original HTTP 2xx), `1` for failure (original 4xx/5xx).
- Normalizes HTTP status codes: `200/401/404/500` are kept; other 5xx become `500`; everything else (201, 204, 403, 422, 429, ...) becomes `200`.

So a successful create returns HTTP **200** with `code: 0` (original 201 normalized), a validation failure returns HTTP **200** with `code: 1` (original 422 normalized), while `401` (Unauthenticated), `404` (Not Found) and `500` (Server Error) keep their status. The `code` field is the reliable success/failure indicator — do not rely solely on the HTTP status.

Common response shapes:

- Success with data: `{ "success": true, "data": <payload>, "code": 0 }`
- Success with message: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "code": 0 }`
- Business error: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "code": 1 }`
- Validation error: `{ "message": "...", "errors": { "field": ["..."] }, "code": 1 }`
- Unauthenticated: `{ "message": "Unauthenticated.", "code": 1 }` (HTTP 401)

## Phone format

Mainland China phone numbers only: regex `^1[3-9]\d{9}$` (11 digits starting with 1).

post.description: Authenticate a user with an account name, email, or phone number plus a password. Returns a JWT access token and the authenticated user summary.

post.description: Invalidates the current JWT token (blacklists it).
Blacklists the current token and issues a new JWT. The new token must be used for subsequent requests.

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token returned by the auth endpoints. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

login.description: Account name, email, or phone number.

phone.description: Mainland China phone number (must be unique if provided).

roles.description: Role codes to assign. Each must exist in `roles.name`.
Role codes to sync (replaces existing roles).
Role codes to assign. Each must exist in `roles.name`.

permissions.description: Permission names to grant. Each must exist in `permissions.name`.

keep_alive.description: Whether to keep the component alive.

always_show.description: Always show the root menu even with one child.

code.description: Role code / identifier (stored in Spatie's `name` column; must be unique).

menu_ids.description: Menu ids to assign (full sync). Omit or send empty to clear.

data_scope_dept_ids.description: Custom department ids. Required only when `data_scope` is `2` (DeptCustom).

role_ids.description: Role ids to assign (full sync). Omit or send empty to clear.

TokenResponse.description: JWT token response returned by auth endpoints.

TokenUser.description: Authenticated user summary embedded in the token response.

User.description: Full user model (as returned by the user endpoints; `password` and `remember_token` are hidden).

roles.description: Roles loaded with the user (raw Spatie Role serialization including ruoyi fields).

Role.description: Role (raw model serialization, as embedded in user responses). The Spatie `name` column holds the role code.

pivot.description: Pivot row when the role is loaded via a user relation.

RoleResource.description: Role resource (role endpoints). `name` is the display name; `code` is the role identifier.

PermissionInfo.description: Permission/menu info for the logged-in user.

menus.description: Menu tree assigned to the user's roles (nested via children).

MenuTreeNode.description: Menu tree node (MenuResource shape with optional `children`).

UserPagination.description: Laravel paginator payload (the `data` field of the list-users response).

SuccessEnvelope.description: Success response with no data payload.

SuccessDataEnvelope.description: Base success response envelope. A `data` property is added per endpoint.

ValidationErrorResponse.description: Laravel validation error response (original HTTP 422 normalized to 200; code: 1).

password: The password must be at least 6 characters.

DataScope.description: Data scope (1 = All, 2 = DeptCustom, 3 = DeptOnly, 4 = DeptAndChild, 5 = Self).
